text: Blocking ssh/rsync/verify inserted into the single-task in-band post-exec path — NAS latency/hangs block the only dispatcher slot; no throughput or failure budget
Terminal `failed` is the wrong default for transient NAS infra failures — converts content-good/NAS-bad into noisy false-failures; distinguish local-content failure from remote-infra failure

Exit-code inconsistency (CRITICAL): `ok=exitCode===0` but Ratatoskr decides success by parsing `**Exit code:** (\d+)` from human markdown, not the status tag — a delivery-failed task could render `Exit code: 0` and report success on Telegram
Log-capture claim is false — `executeSdkTask` closes the log stream before returning; post-exec delivery cannot rely on SDK log plumbing, needs explicit appendLog dependency
Restart/timeout/cancel semantics unsafe — lease/cancel watch stop before the exfil site; no durable handoff between agent-content and delivery; startup recovery writes generic failed result
`wc -c` is a weak integrity check (same-size stale file passes); no idempotency key; partial-delivery cleanup undesigned — use sha256 + temp path + atomic rename + per-artefact state
SSH/rsync dependency operationally under-specified — service file does not set HOME; no known_hosts/BatchMode/NAS-reachability probe; needs deploy-time preflight
Plan couples core dispatcher to one NAS identity/path layout; arbitrary manifests become arbitrary ssh targets — needs a DeliveryTarget abstraction or at least a delivery allowlist
Reversibility missing — should follow the existing HUGIN_*_POLICY env pattern with off/warn/defer/require staged enforcement
Submit-time manifest validation is not optional — placeholder/malformed manifest must reject at parse/claim time before the paid spike, not be caught post-spike by verify
`### Prompt` extraction is prompt-to-EOF; `### Artifacts` after it leaks the manifest to the agent — grammar must force `### Artifacts` before `### Prompt`, with a test

Schema-version 'no bump' decision holds under consumer grep (Ratatoskr/broker/mcp don't pin schemaVersion or exhaustively switch outcome), but the plan overstated the evidence and old Zod readers strip the optional field — delivery state must also live in tags+markdown
First-revision fix `exitCode: "DELIVERY_FAILED"` is WRONG — Ratatoskr's `(\d+)` regex no-matches non-numeric and defaults to success; must use a positive integer (e.g. 2) + `Failure kind:` line

Checkpoint must be nonterminal AND keep the task claimed with an active lease — `delivery:pending` paired with terminal status lets Ratatoskr stop and read the checkpoint as final; paired with `pending` lets the dispatcher re-execute
`delivery:*` tags are not persistent today — buildClaimTags lease renewal and buildTerminalStatusTags both drop them unless explicitly added to the persistent set
Reconciliation reentrancy — active path, startup recovery, lease reaper, and shutdown can race into duplicate delivery; needs a single shared CAS ownership model
structured `result-structured` cannot represent `delivery:pending` without lying (lifecycle is terminal-only) — use a separate checkpoint key / write structured result once at terminal finalize

Host allowlist alone is inadequate — needs a target tuple allowlist (user/host/remote-path-prefix/local-staging-prefix), argv with no shell interpolation, and must not reuse the fetch egress allowlist

Adjacent existing bug — recovery/shutdown write `- **Exit code:** -1`; Ratatoskr's `(\d+)` does not match the minus sign, so those mis-render as success. New path must use positive codes; file the adjacent bug separately
Default `defer` has no downstream owner without a reconciler + retry budget + budget-exhaustion terminalization; would look stuck

Deploy preflight is necessary but not sufficient — an interactive deploy-time probe can pass while the long-running systemd user unit later lacks env/keys/known_hosts/NAS; runtime failure handling + checkpoint are the real safety net
